note: The gate. A command's recorded cases run when its name appears in `activated`, and not otherwise; adding a name is an approval act that judges whether the recorded output is good. Four categories, and every command with prose or rulings at the pin falls in exactly one: `activatable` has cases and can be approved; `unseeded` carries no behavior at the pin, so there is nothing to approve and no activation path exists; `unrecorded` has behavior but no case exercises it. See docs/decisions/0001-corpus-activation-gate.md.

unrecorded.reason: the registry namespace is a late addition at the pin; the case catalog covers it only indirectly, through the top-level help page and one behavior ruling, so no invocation of it was recorded
